idea: Use an empty-cell two-level grid closed form: in a k1×k1 coarse grid, each cell is either one square, a j×j subgrid with a single global j, or left empty. With a full, b subdivided and e empty cells, count = a + b·j² and sum = (a + b·j)/k1. Enumerate (k1, j, a, b) over a + b + e = k1² to hit n exactly, without zero-padding waste.
